title: Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
benefit_category: Inpatient Hospital Services, Outpatient Hospital Services Incident to a Physician's Service, Physicians' Services
indications_limitations: <p>Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is a covered surgical procedure in which a diseased gall bladder is removed through the use of instruments introduced via cannulae, with vision of the operative field maintained by use of a high-resolution television camera-monitor system (video laparoscope). For inpatient claims, report the diagnosis code for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. For all other claims, report the appropriate CPT code for laparoscopy, surgical; cholecystectomy (any method), and the appropriate CPT code for laparoscopy, surgical: cholecystectomy with cholangiography.</p>
revision_history:
